No data exfiltration, network calls, or suspicious operations occur during the sourcing phase. All potentially executable logic is confined to the `check()`, `build()`, and `package()` functions, which are not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. Therefore, this PKGBUILD is safe for this stage of processing.
</details>
